reason: Forced-token, second-decision and second-level forced continuations get content-addressed ids and seeds (a hash of the forced prefix) instead of opening-index tags, and a cached continuation is reused only for the same prefix length and template. Fixes a cache-key collision found when amendment 2 reordered the L-T1 openings; the 984 affected L-T1 rows were moved to data/continuations_superseded.jsonl and L-T1/L-T03 are re-located from scratch for those stages (grid and refinement rows are content-stable and reused). Gemma (committed earlier) is unaffected.
